profile_id_rate_unit: 100ops means 100 offered workload operations per second; guest kernel baseline remains HZ250
qualification: proposed fixed performance profile; no AMD or simulator execution yet

linux.kernel_config_pin: W2 supplies exact Linux source/image/config; NO_HZ_IDLE mandatory; declared initial HZ250 cannot change silently
linux.clock_policy: qualified branch progress converted by measured native ns/branch; page/PMC mechanism declared byW2; no1us-per-clock-read charge
linux.execution_profile: precise-preemption primary subject toW5a; cooperative fallback would be a separately admitted profile
linux.entropy_and_instruction_admission: W2/W5b qualification required for Linux/JVM/JIT paths; fixture preparation admits none

workload.key_selection: unsigned remainder of SplitMix64 finalizer(seed XOR operation_index); no host RNG
workload.offer_policy: operation i offered at epoch + i*10000000ns; queued if previous operation still running; record lag, never silently drop offered work
workload.warmup_policy: same JVM and connections; exercise GET, SET, payload construction, SHA256 and timer waits; restore known dataset then WAIT before ready
workload.reads: GET from primary; exact bytes must equal the client model after acknowledged SETs
workload.writes: SET on primary; OK advances model; any ambiguous/unacknowledged operation fails this performance profile, no retry
workload.admin_commands: BGREWRITEAOF once at or after 40s; counted separately from 6000 GET/SET operations
workload.replica_checks: after 60s, SET marker and WAIT1 on same connection; compare all 1024 keys against acknowledged client model
workload.timing_violation: any individual command running over timeout or total active phase over61s fails; lag and actual drain still reported

faults.selector: all primary<->replica Ethernet frames in both directions
faults.existing_connections: retain TCP state, drop frames; do not reset connections

network.schedule_policy: exact scheduled device arrival under W1 safe horizon; <=1000000ns busy slices are necessary but not sufficient. End slices at or before earlier known affecting deadlines, every producer's proven earliest unpublished effect plus guaranteed minimum path latency, controller/shared-device zero-lookahead barriers, and equal-time closure. Record legal guest IRQ acceptance and handler delay separately; advancing past an unprocessed due world effect is a scheduling error.
network.safe_horizon_owner: W1 computes and validates causal progress; this fixture supplies latency and workload assumptions only
network.qualification: proposed fixture assumptions; not selected silently to meet10x; any change requires a new profile_id

disk.flush_contract: prior completed writes durable when flush completes; world owns completion order
disk.power_failure: not in this performance scenario; everysec acknowledgments are not individually durable promises

jvm.linux_measurement_jdk_pin: OpenJDK21.0.12.1+1 from sharedlocked nixpkgs; final guest qualification required
jvm.darwin_preparation_jdk: Zulu21.0.11+10-LTS; distinct local source/mock preparation runtime
jvm.pinning: exact JDK/Redis store closures from shared Nix lock, classpath artifact lock, compiled classes, guest kernel/config, host kernel/CPU/microcode and snapshot manifest required at measurement
jvm.admission: JIT, GC and JVM instructions/entropy/clocks remain subject to the guest profile; do not claim admission from local smoke

snapshot.point: client ready, blocked waiting for START; both Redis datasets reconciled; no client workload outstanding
requires: all3VM CPU/KVM state+RAM including warmed JVM/JIT
volatile and durable disk state+filesystem caches
snapshot.boot_and_warmup: report cold boot, JVM warmup, dataset reconcile, capture and restore separately
snapshot.qualification: post-warmup manifest describes pinned input; no snapshot/restore correctness claimed by this fixture

measurement.normal_witness: coarse semantic checkpoints every1simulated second plus start/fault/heal/end; full causal-state capture at start/end; always run application checks
measurement.check_witness: W3 boundary chain and dirty RAM+host DMA writes at every semantic boundary; full state at start/end and every1simulated second; capture coverage declared
measurement.denominator: restore START release through client recovery/check completion, including workload/faults/checks/controller/witness and actual drain; excludes boot/warmup/capture
measurement.also_report: 60s-only ratio, fixed60s/end-to-end-host ratio, restore cost, drain seconds, phase and mode breakdown; never hide slow recovery with extra simulated duration
measurement.calibration: native CPU execution ns per retired conditional branch for pinned workload/profile, all benchmark threads and CPL0+3; qualified PMU profile from W5a; never elapsed idle-wall ns per branch
measurement.deciding_qualification: actual guest benchmark,5fresh host processes and independent review; off-host smoke uses no acceptance gate
